svg.aria-label: One StateGraph: One LangGraph StateGraph, six nodes, one conditional edge. The moderator is one function registered at two positions (moderator_open, moderator_distill); it branches on len(transcript) == 0. Termination lives in state: Not in a counter: verdict: str | None is the single source of truth. The judge parses its own output to set it. max_rounds is defence in depth. ReAct only in debater nodes: _run_with_tools() in debate/nodes.py. Moderator, judge and setup stay pure-LLM: they arbitrate structure, not evidence. Run names: Each LLM call carries a run_name like proposer-argument-r1. ReAct iterations add -iter0, -iter1, .... Design history: docs/superpowers/specs/ and docs/superpowers/plans/. Full reference: docs/REFERENCE.md
